title: 信息日报 2026-07-30

headline.title: 美联储按兵不动，亚洲股市反弹，长期美债收益率飙升
headline.summary: 亚洲股市三个交易日来首次上涨，美股期货走高。美联储维持利率不变但三位官员反对，30年期美债收益率升至2007年以来最高。市场对美联储政策路径仍存不确定性。
headline.title_en: Asian Stocks Rebound, Long Bonds Drop After Fed: Markets Wrap
headline.summary_en: Asian shares rose for the first time in three days, US equity-index futures advanced, as a chip-led selloff eased. The Fed held rates steady with three dissents favoring a hike, pushing 30-year Treasury yields to their highest since 2007.
headline.original_title: Asian Stocks Rebound, Long Bonds Drop After Fed: Markets Wrap
headline.reason: 美联储利率决策影响全球市场，亚洲股市反弹与债券收益率飙升形成对比，是当日最受关注的财经事件。
headline.reason_en: The Fed's decision and market reaction dominated global financial headlines, with Asian markets rebounding while long-dated bonds dropped, reflecting deep uncertainty about policy trajectory.
